summary: Frontend-only verification of focus-by-ID highlight on Withdrawals + Company Funds, and crypto-network-required validation on Payment Accounts. All executed checks passed. VIP batch focus skipped (no data). Missing-network badge not observable: all crypto accounts (2x USDT) already have networks (TRC20, ERC20).
critical_code_review_comments: useCompanyFunds focus effect depends on moveRows; on every page/filter change, the focused movement is fetched again and pinned at the top of each page. This is probably intended, but it adds an extra request per page change and makes the page show 51 rows. Optional: cache the fetched row in a ref.
AdminWithdrawals focus effect has the same moveRows-style dependency on items. Minor: it re-fires after each items change only while the record is missing.

Missing-network badge rendering logic (cryptoCodes.has(currency) && !network) looks correct by code review and i18n keys exist in es/en ('sin red'/'no network'), but it could not be exercised with the current data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of executable checks (4/4); 1 not observable due to data
